# Private nested generic carrier

Unmodified Java8 output gives a generic owner and a private static method with
its own shadowing formal. A complete invariant public container holds the
owner's private static generic member on both sides. The public wrapper also
contains an original allocation followed by the private call. Frozen observers
check distinct class/method scopes, private member metadata, opaque payloads,
callback mutations, actual result identity and exact partial failures. No
identity behavior follows from the generic relation; the provider can select
an independent container after its callback.
